CustomField.description: API name of a custom public site to use as the webhook endpoint instead of the auto-created Unlimail Webhooks Endpoint site. When blank, the default auto-created site is used.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Leave blank to use the auto-created site (Unlimail_Webhooks_Endpoint). Set to the API name of any existing public site to use that site for receiving webhook events.
CustomField.label: Custom Site Name
